payload.reason: The evidence provides a qualitative comparison of CGExpan and LM-Base, indicating specific scenarios where their performances differ, particularly in handling user-generated text.

claims.text: CGExpan and LM-Base perform comparably on well-formed concepts but LM-Base outperforms CGExpan on user-generated text concepts.
The performance drop in CGExpan is attributed to its reliance on characteristics of user-generated text, which negatively impacts all ESE methods more significantly than LM-Base.
CGExpan employs more complex mechanisms like iterative expansion and concept name guidance, which may contribute to its performance issues in certain contexts compared to the simpler LM-Base.
